转换一览Conversion index

这些页面不是「我们支持 14 种格式」的另一种说法。格式数只是图的顶点数：14 种格式、48 条注册路径，图上任意一种源格式都能走到全部 11 种可写格式，共 143 个组合，其中界面对用户实际提供 116 个。剩下的 27 个不是没做，而是语义上无效，所以置灰并说明原因——每个配对页面里的「不做什么」写的就是这一类事。These pages are not another way of saying “14 formats supported”. The format count is just the number of vertices: 14 formats and 48 registered direct routes, and every source format reaches all 11 writable ones, which makes 143 combinations reachable and 116 selectable. The other 27 are not missing work — they are semantically invalid, so the picker greys them out and says why. Each pair page spells that class of limits out in its own “what it does not do”.

格式矩阵The format matrix

这张表是把上面那段话摊开写：行是 14 种格式，列是 11 种可写格式，一共 154 个格子，其中 11 格是同一个格式对着自己。剩下的 143 个可达组合里，27 个语义无效，所以界面对用户实际提供 116 个。格子里写的是这条链路实际走的步数——它不是「我们支持 N 种转换」的另一种说法，而是那张「没有手工维护的转换矩阵」被现推出来给你看：48 条注册路径，闭包自己算出这些格子。The grid is that sentence spread out: 14 formats down the side, the 11 writable ones across the top, 154 cells in all, of which 11 are a format meeting itself. Of the remaining 143 reachable combinations, 27 of them are blocked by the policy as semantically invalid, so the picker offers 116. What a cell holds is the number of steps that route actually runs — not another way of saying “we support N conversions”, but the matrix nobody maintains worked out in front of you: 48 registered routes, and these cells are their closure.

行 = 源格式，列 = 目标格式；数字是步数，✕ 是界面置灰的组合，– 是同格式。35 个格子链到对应的说明页。Rows are source formats, columns the writable ones; a digit counts steps, ✕ is a pair the picker greys out, – is the same format. 35 cells link to the page that route has.

图例：数字 = 这条链路走的步数（4 是今天最长的一条，中间产物不落盘）；✕ = 图上可达但语义无效，工作台会置灰并给出原因 —— 「图片无法转换为文本或表格数据（需 OCR，暂不支持）」「PDF 无法可靠转换为表格/结构化数据」；– = 源与目标是同一个格式。带下划线的数字有自己的一页说明，点进去是那条路的保留项与丢弃项；没下划线的格子能转，只是今天还没有专页。Legend: a digit is how many steps that route runs (4 is the longest one today, and no intermediate ever touches the disk); ✕ is reachable in the graph but semantically invalid, so the workbench greys it out and says why — “Images cannot become text or tabular data (needs OCR, not supported)” and “PDF cannot be reliably converted to tabular data”; – is a format meeting itself. An underlined digit has its own page, which spells out what that route keeps and what it drops; a plain one converts, it just has no page yet.

把指针移到任一格，或用 Tab 聚焦矩阵后按方向键逐格走，这里会读出这条链路的完整走法。Hover a cell, or press Tab and walk the grid with the arrow keys, and the full route is read out here.

文档Documents

Markdown、Word、HTML、PDF 之间互转；文档类产物的差别写在各自页面上，尤其 PDF 是图像还是可编辑文档。Markdown, Word, HTML and PDF. The artifacts differ more than the format names suggest, which is why each page says whether it yields an image or something editable.

  • Markdown → Word (.docx)Markdown → Word (.docx) 在浏览器本地把 .md 转成 .docx：标题层级、列表、表格、代码块写成真实 Word 段落，不是截图。批量、可预览、零网络请求。Convert .md to .docx in your browser: headings, lists, tables and code become real Word paragraphs, not a screenshot. Batch, previewable, zero requests.
  • Word (.docx) → MarkdownWord (.docx) → Markdown 浏览器本地把 .docx 转成 Markdown：mammoth 读语义结构，内嵌图片以 data URI 保留，不联网、不排队。支持批量与 ZIP。Turn .docx into Markdown in your browser: mammoth reads the semantic structure, embedded images come along as data URIs. Offline, batch capable, ZIP output.
  • PDF → 纯文本 (TXT)PDF → plain text (TXT) 浏览器本地用 pdf.js 提取 PDF 文字层，输出纯文本或 Markdown。扫描件没有文字层，所以这条对图片型 PDF 无解——项目不含 OCR。pdf.js in your browser pulls the PDF text layer out as .txt or Markdown. A scan has no text layer, so image-only PDFs are a dead end here: the app ships no OCR.
  • Markdown → PDFMarkdown → PDF Markdown → HTML → PDF，本地按 A4 逐页切片成图像型 PDF。好处是哪台机器打开都一样，代价是没有文字层、不可选中检索。Markdown → HTML → PDF, sliced page by page onto A4 locally. It looks identical everywhere; the price is no text layer, so nothing is selectable or searchable.
  • Word (.docx) → PDFWord (.docx) → PDF Word → HTML → PDF：mammoth 读语义结构后整页栅格化，按 A4 切片。文字层没有，版式与 Word 打印不尽相同，先预览再下载。Word → HTML → PDF: mammoth reads the structure, the page is rasterised onto A4. No text layer, and the layout is not Word’s own print output — preview first.
  • Markdown → HTMLMarkdown → HTML 浏览器本地把 .md 渲染成可直接双击打开的完整 HTML：GFM 表格与任务列表可用，样式内联，脚本与事件属性在净化阶段移除。Render .md into a complete, double-clickable HTML document locally: GFM tables and task lists work, styles are inlined, scripts and event attributes removed.
  • HTML → PDFHTML → PDF 浏览器本地把 .html 渲染成多页 A4 PDF：800 px 版心按整页高度切片，切片是无损 PNG；脚本被移除，远程资源不会被取回。Render .html into a multi-page A4 PDF locally: an 800 px layout sliced down its full height, stored as lossless PNG. Scripts are removed; nothing is fetched.
  • PDF → HTMLPDF → HTML 浏览器本地用 pdf.js 按阅读顺序提取文字层，链接标注按协议白名单保留，每页之间插入分页线，产出一个自包含的 .html。全程不上传，也不含 OCR：扫描件没有文字层。pdf.js extracts the text layer in reading order, keeps link annotations through a scheme allowlist and marks page breaks in one self-contained .html. No OCR.
  • PDF → Word (.docx)PDF → Word (.docx) 这条是多步链：pdf.js 先按阅读顺序把文字层提成 HTML，再由它打包成 .docx，中间的 HTML 只在内存里、不会写到你的下载目录。全程离线，无 OCR，也不生成原生 OOXML 段落结构。A two-step chain: pdf.js lifts the text layer into HTML in reading order, that HTML is packed into .docx, and the intermediate never leaves memory. No OCR.
  • Word (.docx) → HTMLWord (.docx) → HTML 浏览器本地用 mammoth 读 .docx 的语义结构（标题、列表、粗斜体、超链接、表格），文档里的图片内联成 data URI，最后经 DOMPurify 净化输出单个 .html。不上传、不装 Office，也不读旧版 .doc。mammoth reads a .docx’s structure — headings, lists, emphasis, links, tables — inline images become data URIs, DOMPurify sanitises the single .html. No .doc.
  • Excel (.xlsx) → PDFExcel (.xlsx) → PDF 这条是多步链：SheetJS 先把每个工作表写成带表名的 HTML 表格，再由它生成 A4 竖版 PDF；中间产物只在内存里。日期不会被读成一串数字，公式值取上次保存时缓存的结果。全程离线。SheetJS writes each worksheet as an HTML table under its name, which becomes a portrait A4 PDF, intermediate held in memory. Formula cells keep cached values.
  • 纯文本 (TXT) → Markdownplain text (TXT) → Markdown 浏览器本地把 .txt 包成带围栏的 Markdown 代码块：内容原样保留，围栏长度会按文本里出现的最长反引号串加长，所以你的三反引号不会把结构撑破。它不猜标题、不猜列表——那是"值保真"与"替你排版"的区别。Wrap a .txt in a fenced Markdown code block verbatim: the fence grows past the longest run of backticks in your text, and it guesses no headings or lists.

数据Data

Excel、CSV、JSON 三方互转，按值而非显示文本序列化；PDF 与图片不提供到表格结构的路径，界面上会置灰并说明原因。Excel, CSV and JSON, serialised from stored values rather than display text. PDF and images have no route into a table structure, and the picker greys those out with a reason.

  • Excel (.xlsx) → CSVExcel (.xlsx) → CSV 浏览器本地把 .xlsx 转成 CSV：按单元格值序列化，日期统一格式，带 UTF-8 BOM，公式注入被转义。多 sheet 每表一份 CSV 装进 ZIP。Convert .xlsx to CSV in your browser from cell values, not display text: dates normalised, UTF-8 BOM, formula injection escaped, one CSV per sheet in a ZIP.
  • CSV → Excel (.xlsx)CSV → Excel (.xlsx) 浏览器本地把 .csv 转成 .xlsx：只有能精确回写的字段才当数字存，长编号与前导零原样保留；GBK/GB18030 编码自动兜底。Convert .csv to .xlsx in your browser: only fields that round-trip exactly become numbers, so long IDs and leading zeros survive. GBK / GB18030 decodes itself.
  • JSON → CSVJSON → CSV 浏览器本地把 JSON 对象数组转成 CSV：表头取所有键的并集，嵌套值以 JSON 文本入格，公式注入被转义，带 UTF-8 BOM。Convert a JSON array of objects to CSV locally: headers are the union of every key, nested values land as JSON text, formula injection is escaped, UTF-8 BOM.
  • Excel (.xlsx) → JSONExcel (.xlsx) → JSON 浏览器本地把 .xlsx 转成 JSON：单表给行对象数组，多表按工作表名分组；数字与布尔是真类型，日期是两段式 ISO 文本。Convert .xlsx to JSON locally: one sheet becomes an array of row objects, several are keyed by sheet name. Numbers and booleans stay typed, dates are ISO text.
  • CSV → JSONCSV → JSON 浏览器本地把 .csv 转成 JSON 行对象：字段先按原文读入，只在「解析→回写完全一致」时才恢复数字类型；GBK / GB18030 自动兜底。Convert .csv to JSON row objects locally: every field starts as text and regains a numeric type only when parse-then-reprint reproduces it exactly.
  • JSON → Excel (.xlsx)JSON → Excel (.xlsx) 浏览器本地把 JSON 数组转成 .xlsx：表头取所有对象键的并集，嵌套对象与数组以 JSON 文本进单元格。链路是 JSON → CSV → Excel，中间不落盘。Turn a JSON array into .xlsx locally: the header is the union of every object’s keys and nested values go into the cell as JSON text, routed via CSV.

图片Images

可写格式为 PNG / JPEG / WebP 三种（浏览器不提供 BMP、GIF、SVG 编码器），这三种只能作为输入。PNG, JPEG and WebP are the writable image formats — a browser ships no encoder for BMP, GIF or SVG, so those three are input-only.

  • PNG → WebPPNG → WebP 浏览器里把 PNG 编成 WebP，透明通道保留，质量档与目标体积先走质量阶梯再缩像素。最多 200 张一批，结果可打 ZIP。Encode PNG to WebP in the browser with alpha preserved. The target-size lever walks the quality ladder before it throws pixels away; 200 images per batch.
  • SVG → PNGSVG → PNG 浏览器本地把 SVG 栅格化成 PNG（也可出 JPEG / WebP）。矢量按当前尺寸渲染，脚本与事件属性先行剥离，外链资源不会去取。Rasterise SVG to PNG in your browser at the size you set: scripts and event attributes are stripped first, and remote resources are never fetched.
  • JPEG → PNGJPEG → PNG 浏览器本地把 .jpg / .jpeg 解码成像素再编为 PNG：尺寸原样，可选最长边，一批最多 200 张可打成一个 ZIP。EXIF 与 GPS 不会跟着走。Decode .jpg to pixels in your browser and re-encode as PNG: dimensions kept, optional longest edge, 200 images in one ZIP. EXIF and GPS do not travel.
  • PNG → JPEGPNG → JPEG 浏览器本地把 PNG 编成 JPEG：透明区域铺纯白展平，质量档 40%–90%、目标体积 20 KB–2 MB，先降质量再缩像素。最多 200 张一批。Encode PNG to JPEG in your browser: alpha flattens onto pure white, with a 40%–90% quality step and a 20 KB–2 MB target that spends quality before pixels.
  • JPEG → WebPJPEG → WebP 浏览器本地把 .jpg 编成 WebP：质量档 40%–90%、目标体积 20 KB–2 MB，先走质量阶梯再缩像素。最多 200 张一批，结果可打 ZIP。Encode .jpg to WebP in your browser with a 40%–90% quality step and a 20 KB–2 MB target — the quality ladder first, pixels second. 200 images per batch.
  • WebP → JPEGWebP → JPEG 浏览器本地把 .webp 解码重编为 JPEG：透明铺纯白，质量档与目标体积照旧，一批最多 200 张。动图 WebP 只会留下一帧。Decode .webp and re-encode as JPEG locally: alpha flattens onto white, quality and target size as usual, 200 per batch. Animated WebP yields one frame.
  • PNG → PDFPNG → PDF 浏览器本地把 PNG 装进单页 PDF：常规路径不重画像素，页面尺寸由图像像素换算，横竖自动。一批最多 200 个，各自一个 PDF。Put a PNG into a one-page PDF locally: the normal path never re-draws pixels, the page takes its size and orientation from the image. 200 files per batch.
  • JPEG → PDFJPEG → PDF 浏览器本地把 .jpg 装进单页 PDF：页面按像素尺寸换算、横竖自动。这条路解码后再编码一次，PNG 那条则不重编码，两者是有损与无损的对照。Put a .jpg into a one-page PDF locally, sized from its pixels with orientation handled. This route decodes and re-encodes once; the PNG route does not.
  • PDF → JPEGPDF → JPEG 浏览器本地用 pdf.js 把 PDF 逐页渲染成 JPEG：渲染密度四档 96 / 144 / 200 / 300 DPI（默认 144）、质量档 40%–90%、可指定最长边，多页自动一页一张装进 ZIP。文件不出本机，也不含 OCR。Render each PDF page to JPEG at 96, 144, 200 or 300 DPI (144 by default), quality 40%–90%, optional longest edge; multi-page batches arrive as a ZIP.
  • PDF → PNGPDF → PNG 浏览器本地用 pdf.js 把 PDF 逐页渲染成 PNG：渲染密度四档 96 / 144 / 200 / 300 DPI（默认 144）、可指定最长边，多页自动一页一张装进 ZIP。PNG 没有质量档也不吃目标体积——无损的意思是不替你决定丢哪些像素。文件不出本机，也不含 OCR。Render each PDF page to PNG at 96, 144, 200 or 300 DPI with an optional longest edge, one image per page in a ZIP. PNG takes no quality step: it is lossless.
  • PDF → WebPPDF → WebP 浏览器本地把 PDF 逐页渲染成 WebP：密度四档 96 / 144 / 200 / 300 DPI、质量档 40%–90%、可指定最长边，多页一页一张装进 ZIP。它与 JPEG 的差别只有体积与容器兼容性——渲染前一样先铺白底，所以这条路没有透明输出。文件不出本机。Render each PDF page to WebP at 96–300 DPI, quality 40%–90%, one image per page in a ZIP. Like the JPEG route it paints the page white first: no transparency.
  • HTML → PNGHTML → PNG 浏览器本地把 .html 渲染到画布再编码为 PNG：800 px 宽、按内容实际高度出整页长图，远程引用与脚本在渲染前就被处理掉。全程不出本机，没有截图软件、也没有服务端渲染。Render a .html file to a canvas and encode it as PNG: 800 px wide, one tall image as long as the content is, with remote references never fetched.
  • GIF → PNGGIF → PNG 浏览器本地把 GIF 解码后编成 PNG：静态图无损换容器，动图取首帧并在结果卡片上写明丢了帧。BMP / GIF / SVG 只能作为输入——浏览器不提供它们的编码器，所以这条的方向不可逆。Decode a GIF and encode it as PNG: a still gets a lossless container swap, an animation keeps its first frame and says so on the result card. One-way only.
  • BMP → PNGBMP → PNG 浏览器本地把 .bmp 解码后编成 PNG：像素尺寸与颜色原样带走，不再叠有损压缩。BMP 只能作为输入（浏览器不提供它的编码器），所以这条方向不可逆；一批最多 200 张，结果可打 ZIP。Decode a .bmp and encode it as PNG in your browser: pixel size and colour carry over with no lossy pass. BMP is input-only, so the route does not run backwards.
  • BMP → JPEGBMP → JPEG 浏览器本地把 .bmp 解码后编成 JPEG：质量档 40%–90%、目标体积 20 KB–2 MB、可指定最长边，够不着目标时先降质量再缩像素。BMP 只能作为输入，方向不可逆。Decode a .bmp and encode it as JPEG with a 40%–90% quality step, a 20 KB–2 MB target and an optional longest edge — quality gives way before pixels do.
  • SVG → JPEGSVG → JPEG 浏览器本地把 .svg 栅格化后编成 JPEG：先净化掉脚本与事件属性、按 width / viewBox 定尺寸（都没有时按 1024 px 方形），再画到画布编码。SVG 只能作为输入，方向不可逆；需要透明请改选 PNG 或 WebP。Rasterise a .svg to JPEG: scripts and event attributes are sanitised out first, size comes from width / viewBox (else a 1024 px square). SVG is input-only here.
  • SVG → WebPSVG → WebP 浏览器本地把 .svg 栅格化后编成 WebP：带 Alpha，所以透明图形的背景能留住；质量档 40%–90%、目标体积 20 KB–2 MB、最长边可调。尺寸按 width / viewBox 推断，外部引用一律不请求。Rasterise a .svg to WebP locally — the SVG route that keeps transparency, with quality, target size and longest edge adjustable and nothing external fetched.

这里列出的是常被搜索的配对，不是全部 116 个；工作台里的目标格式下拉按批次实时给出可用项。This index lists the pairs people search for, not all 116; the workbench shows what is available for the exact batch you dropped in.
